1 of 12STUDIOS EARN AN A
FOR AI READINESS

12 studios compete for West Houston's dance students. Few have finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 12 dance and ballroom studios serving the West Houston market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI. The sites range from 52 to 99. The AI engines name only seven of the 12. The field averages 71 (C) on AI readiness, 11 of 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 7 of 12 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 3 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the West Houston, TX area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 12 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Dance Journey Studios (99) and Houston Ballroom Dance (83) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 52. One score is shared.
  • One of 12 earn an A for AI readiness. The field averages 71 (C).
  • 11 of 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 7 of 12 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. Only one has both.
  • Four of the 12 are franchise locations (three Fred Astaire and one Dance With Me); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #12 is 47 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. In its two answers, Perplexity cited studios' own websites (dancewithmeusa.com, fredastaire.com). The studios named most are the ones those sources already describe clearly.
  • Being unmistakably “in West Houston.” Studios that serve West Houston from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Month 2-3Broaden content to match how buyers askContent built around both the specialist and the generic query, and around the city buyers actually search.
OngoingOff-site signal buildingReviews, directory consistency, third-party mentions.
Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (12 studios): dancejourney.studio, houstonballroomdance.com, fredastaire.com/design-district, fredastaire.com/houston-katy, fredastaire.com/houston, usdancecompany.com, dancewithmeusa.com/studio/katy-tx-dance-studio, thepalladiumhouston.com, memorialdancesport.com, elsabordehoustondanceacademy.com, mxtdance.com, classicdancestudio.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 3 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for West Houston dance searches. Fred Astaire Design District and US Dance Company were added because the AI engines named them for west Houston ballroom; El Sabor de Houston Dance Academy was added from the west Houston salsa search, and Dance With Me Katy from its BDD listing. Left out: Beginners Only Social Ballroom & Latin Dance Studio (no website), DanceVision's Memorial branch (it shares one website with DanceVision Plano, ranked on the Plano page), kids, recital, ballet and fitness studios, and studios in central Houston, The Woodlands, Cypress, Jersey Village and Sugar Land, which belong to other Dance Booking Rank areas.

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 3 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Dance With Me, Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in west Houston, TX?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in west Houston, TX?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT and Perplexity logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 3 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons west houston tx”; “dance lessons west houston tx”; “salsa lessons west houston tx”; “ballroom dance lessons katy tx”; “dance lessons katy tx”; “ballroom dance lessons houston tx”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in west houston tx” and “ballroom dance studio west houston”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
